flow_summary: The interviewer successfully navigated a challenging, disorganized patient persona by consistently re-asking questions when the patient was confused or deflected. The system maintained a professional tone and effectively managed the intake process, including the PHQ-9 and GAD-7, despite the patient's tendency to ramble.

issues.evidence: In the general information section, the interviewer occasionally jumped to a new topic (e.g., gender) when the patient was still struggling to clarify their name, though this did not prevent the collection of necessary data.

The interviewer's responses were strictly functional and lacked brief acknowledgments of the patient's distress, particularly after the disclosure of a suicide attempt and ongoing passive suicidal ideation.
